hero.title: Treneeyɛ
hero.lead: IATF yɛ adwuma wɔ baguam. Nhyehyɛeɛ gyinaesi, mmara nsesae, nniso nsesaeɛ, ne dwuma a wɔdi ho ka no, wɔtwerɛ wɔ bagua mu. Saa kratafa yi kyerɛ baabi a krataa biara te ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so kenkan no.

items: Adwuma ho gyinaesi. Nkrataa a wogye tom, a wɔkora so, ne nea wɔsan de di dwuma no, wɔkyerɛw no sɛ nsɛm a wɔayi no adi anaa nea wɔayi adi wɔ baabi a wɔakora ho nsɛm no, na wɔtwerɛ no tiawa wɔ baguam adansedi krataa no mu. twerԑtohɔ. yɛ bɛ

Hwehwɛ kyerɛwtohɔ. Public request records are stored in the IATF GitHub organization, on this website, or both. records may summarize, redact, or restructure the original request so the accessibility need can be reviewed without exposing unnecessary personal information. Discord decisions are summarized into the public record when they affect a project or governance decision. Request records are excluded from search engine indexing where technically practical. View records: first publication request pending.

Nniso a ɛsakra. Wͻn a wͻwͻ "Governance" kratafa no mu no, wͻdi wͻn akyi sε wͻde wɔn ho rehyɛ amanne no mu. IATF wɛbsaet Hwε nkrataa a wכde asεm no ato hכ no so. kɔyɛ abakɔsɛm wɔ GitHub so.

Dwumadi ho akatua. IATF ma dwumadie no ho ka ba fam, na ɛrekyerɛ dwumadie no mu ka a ɛsan ba no. Efi afe 2022 no, nneɛma a ɛtaa ba no yɛ domain din. Saa berɛ no, sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yie a, wɔde free-tier anaa low-cost dwumadie no di dwuma. Hwɛ dwumadie no ka ho kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛwɔ ase ha no.

Nkyerεkyerεmu a ɛfa nhyehyεe ho. Akwankyerԑ a' yԑagye atoom biara anaa gyinaesi biara a' ԑwↄ sԑ yԑde yԑn ho bԑto gua wɔ GitHub Discussions on the relevant repository view Nkɔmmɔ wɔ IATF wɛbsaet akoraeɛ.

paragraphs: IATF hyɛ da yɛ n'afedie no nketenkete.Efi afe 2022 no, adwuma no ho ka a ɛtaa ba no yɛ domain din.
Saa kyerɛwtohɔ yi nyɛ sikasɛm ho nkrataa a wɔadi ho dwuma. ɛyɛ baguam a wɔde yɛ adwuma ho akontaahyɛde a wɔde di dwuma ma IATF di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so.
operatingCosts.footnote: Wobɛtumi de nkrataa a wo nsa aka no atwe adwene asi so anaa woatwe bi ato so wɔ bere a wɔayɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ no. Nkrataa a ɛfa wo ho, nneɛma a wɔde tua wo ka, ne ɛho nsɛm a ɛho nhia no nka baguam adansedi no ho.

paragraphs: Wɔde nneɛma bi sie wɔ baguam kyerɛwtohɔ mu wɔ atirimpɔw bi nti:
items: Nkrataa ahodoɔ a etwa sɛ yɛhyehyɛ wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu
Nkrataa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ kokoam nkutoo de siesie adesrɛde ansa na wɔagye, wɔapo, anaa wɔaka no tiawa.
Adansedi ahorow, telefon nɔma, ne ankorankoro ho nsɛm a ɛho nhia.
Biribiara a ɛbɛma wɔahu obi a ɔde mmoa a wɔde di dwuma no di dwuma bere a onni ho kwan no.
Raw Discord nkɔmmɔbɔ, gye sɛ wɔde nkrataa pɔtee bi hyɛ da twe kɔ baguam dwumadi no mu.
